_comment: The 29 recommended exhibitions (A start here, B deepen a theme, C optional). Weekdays are mon…sun. See docs/GUIDES.md. 29 个推荐展览；星期写作 mon…sun。

items.name: Fondation Henri Cartier-Bresson
items.subtitle: Nicaragua, Histoire, Mémoire / Images, presse et luttes féministes
items.why: See how a documentary photograph acquires new political and collective meanings through circulation; compare image-making with its later use.
items.whyZh: 看一张纪实照片如何在流传中获得新的政治意义和集体意义；比较影像的拍摄与它后来被如何使用。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周日 11:00–19:00；最晚入场 18:20；周一闭馆
items.price: €10; reduced €6 only if eligible.
items.priceZh: €10；优惠票 €6，仅限符合条件者。

image.caption: Installation de Fuite devant les bombardements, Estelí. La Garde nationale a repris la ville aux mains des rebelles sandinistes, 20 septembre 1978. Série Reframing History, aux environs d’Estelí, 2004
image.alt: Exhibition image: Installation de Fuite devant les bombardements, Estelí. La Garde nationale a repris la ville aux mains des rebelles sandinistes, 20 septembre 1978. Série Reframing History, aux environs d’Estelí, 2004
image.altZh: 展览图片：Installation de Fuite devant les bombardements, Estelí. La Garde nationale a repris la ville aux mains des rebelles sandinistes, 20 septembre 1978. Série Reframing History, aux environs d’Estelí, 2004

items.name: Ithaque
items.subtitle: Heure de pointe
items.why: Study the small gestures and changing relationships between people and the street; look closely at the silver-gelatin prints.
items.whyZh: 研究人与街道之间细微的姿态和不断变化的关系；近距离细看明胶银盐照片。
items.note: Venue dates start 27 Oct; festival lists 12 Nov. Opening on 12 Nov, 18:00–21:00. The venue mislabels that date as Wednesday; it is Thursday.
items.noteZh: 画廊公布的展期从 10月27日开始，摄影节则写 11月12日。11月12日 18:00–21:00 开幕。画廊把这一天误标为周三，实际是周四。

image.caption: Porte de Champerret (December 2025) #2, 2025. Archival silver gelatin print
image.alt: Exhibition image: Porte de Champerret (December 2025) #2, 2025. Archival silver gelatin print
image.altZh: 展览图片：Porte de Champerret (December 2025) #2, 2025。收藏级明胶银盐照片

items.name: Thaddaeus Ropac
items.subtitle: L’Essence du portrait
items.why: Compare a precisely controlled portrait with the sense of spontaneous presence it produces. Pair with Penn at the MEP.
items.whyZh: 比较一张精确控制的肖像与它所营造出的自然、即兴的在场感。可与 MEP 的 Penn 展搭配观看。

image.caption: Irving Penn, Miles Davis Hand on Trumpet, New York, 1986. Gelatin silver print
image.alt: Exhibition image: Irving Penn, Miles Davis Hand on Trumpet, New York, 1986. Gelatin silver print
image.altZh: 展览图片：Irving Penn, Miles Davis Hand on Trumpet, New York, 1986。明胶银盐照片

items.name: MEP · Maison européenne de la Photographie
items.subtitle: PENN & FASHION / pays des merveilles
items.why: Study the construction of fashion images alongside Traoré’s altered film, memory and moving image. A strong comparison of control and instability.
items.whyZh: 研究时尚影像是如何建构的，同时对照 Traoré 经过改造的胶片、记忆与动态影像。这是“控制”与“不稳定”之间一组很有力的对比。
items.price: At desk €13 / reduced €8; online €14 / reduced €9. Proof required.
items.priceZh: 现场购票 €13，优惠票 €8；网上购票 €14，优惠票 €9。优惠票需出示有效证件。
items.note: Primary MEP hours override the shorter Photo Days listing. Traoré ends 29 Nov. Ticket desk closes 30 min before; rooms cleared 15 min before.
items.noteZh: 以 MEP 官方的开放时间为准，不采用 Photo Days 列出的较短时间。Traoré 的展览 11月29日结束。售票处提前 30 分钟停止售票；展厅提前 15 分钟清场。

image.caption: Irving Penn, Issey Miyake Fashion, Face Covered with Hair, New York, 1991
image.alt: Exhibition image: Irving Penn, Issey Miyake Fashion, Face Covered with Hair, New York, 1991
image.altZh: 展览图片：Irving Penn, Issey Miyake Fashion, Face Covered with Hair, New York, 1991

items.name: Jeu de Paume
items.subtitle: Parallax
items.why: Watch how narrative, sound and the viewer’s position build competing versions of history. Allow time for the moving-image works.
items.whyZh: 观察叙事、声音以及观众所处的位置，如何构建出相互竞争的历史版本。请为动态影像作品留出足够时间。
items.address: 1 Place de la Concorde, Jardin des Tuileries, 75001 Paris
items.price: €14; students €7.50 Tue–Fri, €9.50 weekend, with proof.
items.priceZh: €14；学生周二至周五 €7.50，周末 €9.50，需出示有效证件。

image.credit: © Stan Douglas. Courtesy de l’artiste et des galeries Victoria Miro et David Zwirner
image.caption: Hastings Park, 16 July 1955, 2008. De la série Crowds and Riots
image.alt: Exhibition image: Hastings Park, 16 July 1955, 2008. De la série Crowds and Riots
image.altZh: 展览图片：Hastings Park, 16 July 1955, 2008. De la série Crowds and Riots

items.name: LE BAL
items.subtitle: L’Espace entre nous
items.by: Wilson Centre collection; including Elinor Carucci, Francesca Woodman, Tomoko Sawada and Susan Meiselas
items.why: Ask what changes when photographer and subject collaborate, confront each other or share an intimate space.
items.whyZh: 思考当摄影师与被摄者合作、相互对峙，或共处一个私密空间时，会发生什么变化。
items.hours: SPECIAL 11–15 Nov: 11:00–19:00; last entry 18:30. Usual Wed 12:00–20:00, Thu–Sun 12:00–19:00; closed Mon/Tue
items.price: €10 / students €6; students free on Wednesdays with proof.
items.priceZh: €10，学生 €6；学生周三免费入场，需出示有效证件。
items.note: 14 Nov signings: 12:00 Meeks/Fridlyand; 13:00 Meiselas/Depoorter; 17:00 Sevinçli. Verify individual participation and capacity.
items.noteZh: 11月14日签售：12:00 Meeks/Fridlyand；13:00 Meiselas/Depoorter；17:00 Sevinçli。每位摄影师是否到场、名额是否有限，请自行核实。

image.credit: © Center for Creative Photography, Arizona Board of Regents. Courtesy Wilson Centre for Photography
image.caption: John Gutmann, Haussement d’épaules, 1935
image.alt: Exhibition image: John Gutmann, Haussement d’épaules, 1935
image.altZh: 展览图片：John Gutmann, Haussement d’épaules, 1935

items.name: Maubert
items.subtitle: Que vos pas soient légers, car vous marchez sur mes rêves
items.why: Look at how Polaroid, solarisation and collage carry exile, family bonds and absence through the physical image.
items.whyZh: 观察宝丽来、中途曝光和拼贴如何通过实体影像，承载流亡、家庭纽带与缺席。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 12:00–19:00；也可预约参观
items.note: Venue starts 6 Nov; Photo Days starts 5 Nov. Difference does not affect this guide’s 8–15 Nov window.
items.noteZh: 画廊展期从 11月6日开始，Photo Days 则从 11月5日开始。这一差异不影响本导览 11月8日至15日的时间范围。

image.caption: Portrait de femme en blanc, Paris, 1994. Tirage noir et blanc baryté d’après négatif Polaroïd 55
image.alt: Exhibition image: Portrait de femme en blanc, Paris, 1994. Tirage noir et blanc baryté d’après négatif Polaroïd 55
image.altZh: 展览图片：Portrait de femme en blanc, Paris, 1994. Tirage noir et blanc baryté d’après négatif Polaroïd 55

items.name: Quai de la Photo
items.subtitle: Teenage Dream
items.why: See what is gained and lost when anonymous family snapshots become a public story about adolescence.
items.whyZh: 看看匿名的家庭快照变成一个关于青春期的公共故事时，得到了什么，又失去了什么。
items.hours: Winter: Wed–Sun from 12:00; at least until midnight, up to 02:00. Closed Mon/Tue
items.hoursZh: 冬季：周三至周日 12:00 起开放，至少到午夜，最晚到 02:00。周一、周二闭馆
items.price: Free entry.
items.priceZh: 免费入场。
items.note: Use venue address Port de la Gare, not the official-map wording “quai”. Venue end date is 20 Dec, not map’s 22 Dec. Late closing varies; choose daytime for quiet viewing.
items.noteZh: 请使用场馆地址 Port de la Gare，不要用官方地图上“quai”的写法。场馆展期到 12月20日结束，而不是地图上写的 12月22日。夜间闭馆时间不固定；想安静看展，请白天去。

image.caption: USA, 1981
image.alt: Exhibition image: USA, 1981
image.altZh: 展览图片：USA, 1981

items.name: Union de la Jeunesse Internationale
items.subtitle: Being There
items.why: Examine how re-enactment and clothing place a Black presence inside mid-century American snapshots and question who belongs in an archive.
items.whyZh: 审视重演与服装如何把黑人的在场放进二十世纪中叶的美国快照里，并追问：谁有资格出现在档案之中？
items.note: Opening party 14 Nov from 20:00 is a separate event. Admission price not stated by Photo Days.
items.noteZh: 11月14日 20:00 起的开幕派对是另一场独立活动。Photo Days 没有公布门票价格。

image.alt: Exhibition image: Being There
image.altZh: 展览图片：Being There

items.name: BnF François Mitterrand
items.subtitle: Scènes, signes, sensations — Japanese photographs, 1945–2025
items.by: Group exhibition; including Shōji Ueda, Daidō Moriyama, Eikō Hosoe and Tokuko Ushioda
items.why: Compare documentary, theatrical and sensory approaches across post-war Japanese photography; study the relationship between books and prints.
items.whyZh: 比较战后日本摄影中纪实、戏剧化与感官化的不同路径；研究摄影书与照片原作之间的关系。
items.address: BnF François-Mitterrand, Galerie 2, Quai François Mauriac, 75013; entrance from Rue Émile-Durkheim
items.hours: Tue–Sat 10:00–19:00; Sun 13:00–19:00; closed Mondays and public holidays
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 10:00–19:00；周日 13:00–19:00；周一及公共假日闭馆
items.price: Paid exhibition; verify ticket category on BnF website, guided visits priced separately.
items.priceZh: 收费展览；票种请到 BnF 官网核实，导览另行收费。

image.caption: Shoji Ueda, Paysage de dunes avec ma femme, 1950. Série Dunes de sable. BnF, Estampes et photographie
image.alt: Exhibition image: Shoji Ueda, Paysage de dunes avec ma femme, 1950. Série Dunes de sable. BnF, Estampes et photographie
image.altZh: 展览图片：Shoji Ueda, Paysage de dunes avec ma femme, 1950. Série Dunes de sable. BnF, Estampes et photographie

items.name: Atelier néerlandais
items.subtitle: A Wider Gaze
items.by: Emilia Martin, Giya Makondo-Wills, Julia Gat, Maite Vanhellemont, Mark Rammers, Pablo Lerma, Rafael Roncato, Sanne van den Elzen, Sheng-Wen Lo, Thana Faroq
items.why: Compare how artists use photography, textiles, installation and archives to discuss belonging, labour, colonial histories and migration.
items.whyZh: 比较艺术家如何运用摄影、纺织、装置与档案，讨论归属、劳动、殖民历史与移民。
items.price: Free entry.
items.priceZh: 免费入场。
items.note: Curated by Damarice Amao. Artist encounters 11–13 Nov; 12 Nov 11:30 photo-book event; 14 Nov 11:00–13:00 Trigger/FOMU. Event capacity/registration may apply.
items.noteZh: 策展人：Damarice Amao。11月11日至13日有艺术家见面活动；11月12日 11:30 摄影书活动；11月14日 11:00–13:00 Trigger/FOMU 活动。活动可能有名额限制或需要报名。

image.caption: mother & child, from Mare Internum, 2023 – ongoing
image.alt: Exhibition image: mother & child, from Mare Internum, 2023 – ongoing
image.altZh: 展览图片：mother & child，出自 Mare Internum，2023 年至今

items.name: See Galerie
items.subtitle: Translations
items.why: Look at colour, sets and performed identities: how does a staged scene make a feeling credible?
items.whyZh: 关注色彩、布景和被“表演”出来的身份：一个摆拍的场景，如何让一种情感变得可信？

image.credit: © Elsa & Johanna. Courtesy La Forest Divonne
image.caption: Eternité, Le Lieu d'une attente infinie, 2017
image.alt: Exhibition image: Eternité, Le Lieu d'une attente infinie, 2017
image.altZh: 展览图片：Eternité, Le Lieu d'une attente infinie, 2017

items.name: Paris Photo
items.subtitle: 29th edition
items.why: The week’s largest photography fair, built this year around the bicentenary of photography. Choose two or three sections rather than every booth: the early processes in the Main Sector, the Centre Pompidou’s collection show, and the Book Sector upstairs.
items.whyZh: 本周规模最大的摄影博览会，今年以摄影术诞生两百周年为主线。不必走遍每个展位，挑两三个部分细看：主展区里的早期工艺、蓬皮杜中心的馆藏展，以及楼上的摄影书展区。
items.address: Grand Palais, 3 Avenue du Général Eisenhower, 75008 Paris
items.hours: Thu–Sat 13:00–20:00; Sun 13:00–19:00. The Wed 11 Nov vernissage is for pass holders only
items.hoursZh: 周四至周六 13:00–20:00；周日 13:00–19:00。11月11日（周三）的开幕预展只对持通行证者开放
items.price: Thu/Fri ticket €36; Sat/Sun €41; evening ticket from 17:00 €26; students €26 with proof. A ticket is for one chosen day and can’t be exchanged or refunded.
items.priceZh: 周四、周五票 €36；周六、周日票 €41；17:00 后的晚场票 €26；学生票 €26，需出示证明。门票只限所选的一天，不能更换或退款。
items.note: Book online before the day. No backpacks; suitcases, scooters and helmets can’t be left in the cloakroom. Métro Champs-Élysées–Clemenceau or Franklin D. Roosevelt; RER C Invalides.
items.noteZh: 请提前在网上购票。不能带双肩包；行李箱、滑板车和头盔不能寄存。地铁 Champs-Élysées–Clemenceau 或 Franklin D. Roosevelt 站；RER C 线 Invalides 站。

image.credit: Joseph Szabo. Courtesy of the artist & Jackson Fine Art
image.caption: Night Owls, 1971
image.alt: A black-and-white night photograph of two teenage boys sprawled on a pavement, one shoe kicked off, in front of a shop sign.
image.altZh: 一张黑白夜景照片：两个少年躺在人行道上，其中一人踢掉了一只鞋，背后是一块店铺招牌。

items.name: Polycopies
items.subtitle: Photobook fair on the Seine
items.by: Independent photobook publishers and booksellers; signings at their tables every day
items.why: The independent photobook fair, on a boat below the Quai Anatole France. Compare how sequence, paper and binding change the same pictures, and meet photographers at their publishers’ tables.
items.whyZh: 独立摄影书博览会，设在 Quai Anatole France 下方的一艘船上。比较编排顺序、纸张和装帧如何改变同一组照片，并在出版社的桌前与摄影师交谈。
items.address: Bateau Concorde-Atlantique, Port de Solférino (Berges de Seine), 75007 Paris
items.note: Métro Assemblée Nationale or Concorde; RER C Musée d’Orsay. Some publishers come only Wed–Fri or Sat–Sun, and the signing list changes daily: see polycopies.net.
items.noteZh: 地铁 Assemblée Nationale 或 Concorde 站；RER C 线 Musée d’Orsay 站。部分出版社只在周三至周五或周六、周日到场，签售名单每天更新：见 polycopies.net。

image.alt: A black-and-white photograph of three women standing on a rocky shore below wooded hills, one under an umbrella.
image.altZh: 一张黑白照片：三位女子站在树木覆盖的山丘下的岩岸上，其中一人撑着伞。

items.name: Bourse de Commerce – Pinault Collection
items.subtitle: Remember Me
items.by: About 700 photographs from the Pinault Collection; including Irving Penn, Raymond Depardon, Cindy Sherman, Man Ray and Richard Avedon
items.why: Two hundred years of photography hung without a timeline, so periods and styles meet on the same wall. The same ticket covers a third Irving Penn show this week, to compare with Ropac and MEP.
items.whyZh: 两百年的摄影不按时间顺序陈列，不同时代和风格在同一面墙上相遇。同一张门票还包括本周的第三个 Irving Penn 展，可以和 Ropac、MEP 的两个展对照着看。
items.hoursZh: 周三至周一 11:00–19:00，周五至 21:00；周二闭馆
items.price: €15; €10 for ages 18–26 and students; free under 18. Everyone needs a timed ticket, booked online.
items.priceZh: €15；18至26岁和学生 €10；18岁以下免费。所有人都需要在网上预约分时段门票。
items.note: Nan Goldin’s film in the Auditorium is closed on Fri 13 Nov afternoon and Sun 15 Nov. Expect a queue for the Depardon gallery.
items.noteZh: Nan Goldin 在礼堂放映的影片11月13日（周五）下午和11月15日（周日）不开放。Depardon 展厅可能要排队。

image.credit: © Tadao Ando Architect & Associates, Niney et Marca Architectes, agence Pierre-Antoine Gatier. Photo: Florent Michel
image.caption: View of the exhibition “Remember Me”, Bourse de Commerce – Pinault Collection, Paris, 2026.
image.alt: A gallery view: a blurred visitor walks past small framed seascapes hung in front of a huge black-and-white photograph of the sea.
image.altZh: 展厅一景：一位模糊的观众走过几幅小尺寸的海景照片，它们挂在一张巨幅黑白海面照片前。

items.name: Institut suédois
items.subtitle: An Act of Attention
items.by: Marguerite Bornhauser, Theo Elias, Tom Hallgren, Salad Hilowle, Massao Mascaro, Iris Millot, Ela Polkowska
items.why: Explore image surfaces and expanded photographic forms after an atelier led by Sophie Ristelhueber.
items.whyZh: 探索影像的表面与拓展的摄影形式，作品来自 Sophie Ristelhueber 带领的一期创作课（atelier）。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周日 12:00–19:00；周四开到 21:00；周一闭馆
items.price: Free entry.
items.priceZh: 免费入场。
items.note: Sources disagree on opening: 11/12/13 Nov. Guide uses 13 Nov conservatively; earlier access is unconfirmed.
items.noteZh: 各来源给出的开幕日期不一致，有 11月11日、12日、13日三种说法。本导览保守地采用 11月13日；更早能否入场尚未确认。

image.altZh: 展览图片：Sebastian

items.name: Galerie Putman
items.subtitle: En levko
items.why: Photographs extended through drawing and cut-out processes: attend to the boundary between an observed landscape and its reconstruction.
items.whyZh: 照片经由素描和剪切得到延展：留意眼前观察到的风景与它的重构之间的边界。

image.altZh: 展览图片：En Levko #24, 2026. Tirage pigmentaire et dessin au fusain et pastel sec

items.name: Rabouan Moussion
items.subtitle: Transcripts of a Sea
items.why: Follow an immersive, sustained practice in which the sea is encountered from inside its movement rather than as a distant view.
items.whyZh: 跟随一种沉浸而持续的创作实践：大海不是被远远观看的风景，而是从它的运动内部去遭遇。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 10:00–19:00，展览 11月12日开始
items.note: Opening 12 Nov from 17:00.

image.credit: © Stephan Vanfleteren. Courtesy Galerie Rabouan Moussion
image.caption: Transcripts of a Sea #054841_RB
image.alt: Exhibition image: Transcripts of a Sea #054841_RB
image.altZh: 展览图片：Transcripts of a Sea #054841_RB

items.name: Polka Galerie
items.subtitle: Immersion / Les ruines de Detroit, 20 ans après
items.by: Steve McCurry / Yves Marchand & Romain Meffre
items.why: Compare colour-led documentary with a return to architectural photographs twenty years later; attend to how a project changes through revisiting.
items.whyZh: 比较以色彩为主导的纪实摄影，与二十年后重返建筑照片的创作；留意一个项目如何在重访中发生变化。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 11:00–19:00；展览 11月12日开始
items.note: Opening Thu 12 Nov 18:00–21:00 with the artists; book signing from 19:00.

image.altZh: 展览图片：Steve McCurry, Porbandar, Gujarat, India, 1983

items.name: Angalia
items.subtitle: The future is not ours to see
items.why: A mini-retrospective across seven series by a Kinshasa-based photographer; compare visual worlds across a ten-year practice.
items.whyZh: 一位常驻金沙萨的摄影师的小型回顾展，横跨七个系列；比较她十年创作中的不同视觉世界。

image.caption: The future is not ours to see. Série Terre de lait, terre de miel, 2022

image.altZh: 展览图片：The future is not ours to see. Série Terre de lait, terre de miel, 2022

items.name: Clémentine de la Féronnière
items.subtitle: Lucky Jim
items.why: Self-presentation and friendship connect studio work, Ghana and the UK in an artist’s own archive.
items.whyZh: 在艺术家本人的档案中，自我呈现与友谊把影棚创作、加纳和英国联系在一起。
items.note: The gallery and the directories all say Tue–Sat; closed Sunday and Monday.
items.noteZh: 画廊和各目录网站都写周二至周六；周日和周一闭馆。

image.credit: © James Barnor. Courtesy Galerie Clémentine de la Féronnière

image.altZh: 展览图片：Lucky Jim

items.name: Camion RosAlma
items.subtitle: Concentric Circles
items.why: An image-and-sound installation links Armenian song, dance and bodily practice to living memory and resistance to erasure.
items.whyZh: 一件影像与声音装置，把亚美尼亚的歌曲、舞蹈和身体实践，与鲜活的记忆、对抹除的抵抗联系在一起。
items.note: 12 Nov 18:00–21:00 opening/performance/conversation; 13 Nov 16:30 artist tour: RSVP. Boat/quayside access: check exact entrance.
items.noteZh: 11月12日 18:00–21:00 开幕、表演与对谈；11月13日 16:30 艺术家导览，需预约。展场在船上或码头边，请确认具体入口。

image.caption: Concentric Circles, Kokh, 1
image.alt: Exhibition image: Concentric Circles, Kokh, 1
image.altZh: 展览图片：Concentric Circles, Kokh, 1

items.name: Musée de la Légion d'honneur
items.subtitle: Le théâtre de la mémoire
items.why: Reworked negatives, painted photographs and modest constructions turn photographed objects into small theatres of memory.
items.whyZh: 重新加工的底片、手绘的照片和简朴的搭建，把被拍摄的物件变成一座座记忆的小剧场。
items.address: 2 Rue de la Légion d’Honneur, 75007 Paris
items.hoursZh: 周三至周日 13:00–18:00；周四至 20:00；周一、周二闭馆
items.note: The exhibition opens on 11 Nov (Armistice Day), on purpose. Last entry 17:30; Thu 19:30.
items.noteZh: 展览特意选在11月11日（停战纪念日）开幕。最晚入场 17:30；周四 19:30。

image.alt: Exhibition image: Le théâtre de la mémoire
image.altZh: 展览图片：Le théâtre de la mémoire

items.name: Chapelle St-Vincent-de-Paul · Thomas KLOTZ
items.subtitle: Révélation
items.why: A slow, large-format encounter with religious space; consider how the existing chapel changes the photographs’ presence.
items.whyZh: 以大画幅缓慢地面对宗教空间；思考原有的礼拜堂如何改变照片的在场感。
items.price: Free access as listed.
items.priceZh: 据公布信息免费入场。
items.note: The festival now lists 09:00–18:00; the chapel’s own hours are Mon–Sat 07:00–12:30 / 14:30–18:30 and Sun 07:30–13:00 / 14:30–18:30. Go when both say open, and avoid Mass times.
items.noteZh: 摄影节现在写的是 09:00–18:00；小教堂自己公布的时间是周一至周六 07:00–12:30 / 14:30–18:30，周日 07:30–13:00 / 14:30–18:30。请在两者都开放的时段前往，并避开弥撒时间。

image.credit: © Thomas Klotz. Courtesy Photo Days et Clémentine de la Féronnière
image.caption: Révélation, 2026–2027
image.alt: Exhibition image: Révélation, 2026–2027
image.altZh: 展览图片：Révélation, 2026–2027

items.name: Maison · agnès b.
items.subtitle: 5 jours à Moscou en 1987
items.why: A personal photographic record of Moscow in 1987: compare the curiosity of an encounter with a pre-existing image of a place.
items.whyZh: 一份 1987 年莫斯科的个人摄影记录：比较一次相遇中的好奇，与人们对一个地方早已形成的印象。
items.price: Free access as listed.
items.priceZh: 据公布信息免费入场。
items.note: Closes 13 Nov; no visit on 14 Nov. Saturday hours are outside this exhibition’s final week.
items.noteZh: 11月13日闭展；11月14日无法参观。本展最后一周用不到周六的开放时间。

image.credit: © agnès b. Courtesy galerie du jour agnès b.
image.caption: 5 jours à Moscou en 1987
image.alt: Exhibition image: 5 jours à Moscou en 1987
image.altZh: 展览图片：5 jours à Moscou en 1987

items.name: Dominique Fiat
items.subtitle: PHOTOGRAPHIER L’ACTION
items.by: Günter Brus, Hannah Collins, John Goto, Nicola Lo Calzo, Emo de Medeiros, Chantal Regnault, Sue Williamson
items.why: Consider the photograph as a continuation of performance rather than a neutral record of an action.
items.whyZh: 把照片看作行为表演的延续，而不是对一个动作的中性记录。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周五 15:00–19:00；其他时间需预约
items.note: 12 Nov 18:30–20:00 artist encounter; RSVP via festival page. Do not assume Saturday access.
items.noteZh: 11月12日 18:30–20:00 艺术家见面会；需通过摄影节页面预约。不要默认周六可以入场。

image.caption: Tony Overness, Grandest March Ever (Aids Benefit), Palladium, 1990
image.alt: Exhibition image: Tony Overness, Grandest March Ever (Aids Benefit), Palladium, 1990
image.altZh: 展览图片：Tony Overness, Grandest March Ever (Aids Benefit), Palladium, 1990

items.name: La Hune
items.subtitle: House of Love
items.why: Intimacy and a shared creative household: compare being an observer with being part of the scene.
items.whyZh: 亲密关系与一个共同创作的家庭：比较“旁观者”与“身在其中”的区别。
items.note: 10 Nov 17:30–19:00 festival artist salon: RSVP, conflicts with FotoFilmic’s 18:00 opening.
items.noteZh: 11月10日 17:30–19:00 摄影节艺术家沙龙，需预约；与 FotoFilmic 18:00 的开幕式冲突。

image.caption: Léa Seydoux, 2010
image.alt: Exhibition image: Léa Seydoux, 2010
image.altZh: 展览图片：Léa Seydoux, 2010

items.name: Écho 119
items.subtitle: À marée basse
items.why: Compare photographs of ama divers with poetic and material approaches to the marine world.
items.whyZh: 比较海女（ama）的照片，与从诗意和材质角度呈现海洋世界的作品。

image.caption: Sous l'eau, série AMA, 1965
image.alt: Exhibition image: Sous l'eau, série AMA, 1965
image.altZh: 展览图片：Sous l'eau, série AMA, 1965

items.name: Galerie Eva Meyer
items.subtitle: Paris by Night
items.why: Attend to nocturnal urban surfaces and the relationship between photographic observation and projected images.
items.whyZh: 留意夜间城市的各种表面，以及摄影观察与投影影像之间的关系。
items.note: Opening 12 Nov 17:00–20:00. Special projections on 18 Nov occur after this guide’s week (8–15 Nov).
items.noteZh: 11月12日 17:00–20:00 开幕。11月18日的特别放映在本导览这一周（11月8日至15日）之后。

image.credit: © Deidi von Schaewen. Courtesy Galerie Eva Meyer
image.caption: Paris By Night 29.12.2021. Tirage argento-numérique
image.alt: Exhibition image: Paris By Night 29.12.2021. Tirage argento-numérique
image.altZh: 展览图片：Paris By Night 29.12.2021. Tirage argento-numérique

items.name: Alta Vista Art
items.subtitle: SHE IS THE STORY
items.by: Group exhibition including Christa Blackwood, Jo Ann Chaus, Sarah Hadley, Tama Hochbaum, Bootsy Holler and Sal Taylor Kydd
items.why: A range of women’s practices across self-portraiture, memory, abstraction and collage; compare how different methods carry lived experience.
items.whyZh: 多位女性艺术家的创作，涵盖自拍像、记忆、抽象与拼贴；比较不同方法如何承载亲身经验。
items.hours: 10 Nov 18:00–20:00 (opening); 11–13 Nov 14:00–19:00; 14 Nov 14:00–21:00; 15 Nov appointment only
items.note: 10 Nov 18:00–20:00 opening conflicts with FotoFilmic opening; 14 Nov finissage 18:00–21:00. Saturday afternoon timing is conservatively taken from the official map.
items.noteZh: 11月10日 18:00–20:00 开幕，与 FotoFilmic 的开幕式冲突；11月14日 18:00–21:00 闭幕活动。周六下午的时间保守地采用官方地图的信息。

image.caption: Pink Hydrangeas, 2025
image.alt: Exhibition image: Pink Hydrangeas, 2025
image.altZh: 展览图片：Pink Hydrangeas, 2025

items.name: Galerie Leica Paris
items.subtitle: Théâtre de la couleur
items.why: Colour as the subject: ordinary streets and rooms turned into fields of light. Notice how much of each picture is colour before it is a scene.
items.whyZh: 色彩本身就是主题：普通的街道和房间变成一片片光。留意每张照片里，有多少先是色彩，然后才是场景。
items.price: Free.
items.priceZh: 免费。
items.note: Inside the Leica Store.
items.noteZh: 在 Leica 门店内。

image.credit: © Harry Gruyaert / Magnum Photos. Courtesy Gallery FIFTY ONE
image.caption: France, Paris, 1985
image.alt: A colour street photograph of a woman in a flowered dress walking past empty café tables and orange chairs, in deep shadow and hard sunlight.
image.altZh: 一张彩色街头照片：一位穿碎花裙的女子走过空着的咖啡桌和橙色椅子，画面里是浓重的阴影和强烈的阳光。

items.name: Galerie Roger-Viollet
items.subtitle: Jean Marquis, arpenteur du quotidien. Photographies 1951–1983
items.why: Thirty years of everyday life, from streets to farms and factories, by a Magnum photographer who took up the camera on Robert Capa’s advice. Compare his distance from people with the street pictures at Ithaque.
items.whyZh: 三十年的日常生活，从街道到农场和工厂；作者是一位听从 Robert Capa 的建议拿起相机的玛格南摄影师。把他与人的距离，和 Ithaque 展出的街头照片比较一下。
items.hoursZh: 周二至周六 11:00–19:00；公共假日闭馆
items.price: Free, according to the Roger-Viollet agency.
items.priceZh: 免费（据 Roger-Viollet 图片社）。

image.caption: Dockers in Liverpool. England, 1955.
image.alt: A black-and-white photograph of two dockers in flat caps sitting on a chain railing on a quay, watching tugboats steer a liner through a misty harbour.
image.altZh: 一张黑白照片：两名戴鸭舌帽的码头工人坐在码头的铁链栏杆上，看着拖船引着一艘邮轮驶过雾中的港口。

items.name: Templon
items.subtitle: rose pour toi, rose pour moi
items.why: Staged portraits, each photograph painted by hand, marking fifty years of the duo’s work. Ask where the photograph ends and the painting begins.
items.whyZh: 精心布景的肖像，每张照片都经手工上色，纪念这对搭档合作五十年。想一想：照片在哪里结束，绘画又从哪里开始？

image.caption: Pierre et Gilles, rose pour toi, rose pour moi, TEMPLON Paris, 2026.
image.alt: A gallery view of three large, ornately framed, brightly coloured photo-paintings by Pierre et Gilles on white walls.
image.altZh: 展厅一景：白墙上挂着三幅 Pierre et Gilles 的大幅手绘照片，色彩鲜艳，配有华丽的画框。

items.name: Sixteen
items.subtitle: Sixteen Photography Collection Show
items.by: 23 photographers, including Walker Evans, Mark Steinmetz, Ken Grant, Alys Tomlinson, Koji Onaka and Siân Davey
items.why: A small collection show, from Walker Evans to photographers on their first books. Look for the thread a collector draws between generations, and compare Mark Steinmetz here with his show at Ithaque.
items.whyZh: 一个小型收藏展，从 Walker Evans 到刚出第一本书的摄影师。看看收藏者如何在几代人之间牵起一条线，并把这里的 Mark Steinmetz 和他在 Ithaque 的展览比较一下。

items.name: Galerie Les Filles du Calvaire
items.subtitle: Patria Nostra / La dernière plage
items.why: Three years with recruits of the French Foreign Legion, from selection to their regiments: a study of belonging, and of remaking oneself behind a uniform.
items.whyZh: 三年间跟随法国外籍军团的新兵，从选拔一直到分入各自的团：关于归属，也关于如何在一身制服之下重新塑造自己。
items.address: 17 Rue des Filles du Calvaire, 75003 Paris
items.hours: Tue 14:00–18:30; Wed–Sat 11:00–18:30; closed on public holidays
items.note: Opens Thu 12 Nov, 18:00–21:00. Patria Nostra is on the first floor.
items.noteZh: 11月12日（周四）18:00–21:00 开幕。Patria Nostra 在二楼（法国所说的“一楼”）。

image.credit: © Julie Joubert. Courtesy Galerie Les Filles du Calvaire
image.caption: Patria Nostra (Untitled), 2023
image.alt: Seen from above, a young soldier in camouflage uniform swims through the clear blue water of a pool.
image.altZh: 俯视的画面：一名身穿迷彩服的年轻士兵在清澈的蓝色泳池里游泳。
image.source: Published by Galerie Les Filles du Calvaire
image.sourceZh: 由 Galerie Les Filles du Calvaire 发布

items.name: Atelier 13 Sévigné · FUTURES
items.subtitle: The Ecology of Movement
items.by: Alexandra Baumgartner, Benedetta Casagrande, Diana Lelonek, Santiago Martinez Benedetti, Laure Winants; curated by Julia Rajacic
items.why: Five photographers who build environmental limits into how they work: plant-based developers, home-made cameras, anthotypes, polar ice. A direct way into the material questions this guide keeps asking.
items.whyZh: 五位摄影师把环境的限制纳入创作方法：植物显影液、自制相机、花汁印相、极地冰。这是进入本导览反复提出的材质问题的一条直接途径。
items.note: FUTURES gives both 8–14 and 9–15 Nov; this guide uses only 9–14 Nov. The hours are printed only in the programme picture on the FUTURES page.
items.noteZh: FUTURES 同时写了11月8日至14日和11月9日至15日；本导览只采用11月9日至14日。开放时间只印在 FUTURES 网页上的节目单图片里。

image.alt: A black-and-white print, clipped to a wall, of a blackbird among leaves with a large white feather laid over it.
image.altZh: 一张用夹子固定在墙上的黑白照片：树叶间的一只乌鸫，上面覆着一根大大的白色羽毛。

items.name: delpire & co
items.subtitle: Last Resort
items.why: Books, fanzines and posters made about protest. Ask whether a book can hold personal experience and political pressure at once, then browse the bookshop next to it.
items.whyZh: 为抗议而做的书、小志和海报。想一想：一本书能否同时承载个人经验和政治压力？看完再逛逛旁边的书店。

exceptions.noteZh: Paris Photo 期间特别开放 13:00–19:00。

items.price: Free; talks and breakfasts while places last.
items.priceZh: 免费；讲座和早餐活动名额有限，先到先得。
items.note: Morning and evening events all week; the programme may change.
items.noteZh: 本周每天上午和傍晚都有活动；安排可能变动。

image.alt: A raised hand holds a smoke flare pouring out a thick yellow cloud flecked with confetti against a dark night.
image.altZh: 一只举起的手握着烟火，喷出夹杂着彩纸屑的浓浓黄烟，背景是漆黑的夜空。

items.name: Musée du Louvre
items.subtitle: Louvre Photo
items.by: More than 300 photographs; curated by Quentin Bajac and Dominique de Font-Réaulx
items.why: The museum as a photographic subject, from the first photographers to recent commissions: its works, rooms, visitors and staff. Watch how a camera turns an institution into a picture of itself.
items.whyZh: 把博物馆本身当作摄影题材，从最早的摄影师到近年的委托创作：它的藏品、展厅、观众和员工。看看相机如何把一座机构变成它自己的形象。
items.address: Musée du Louvre, Mezzanine Napoléon; enter by the Pyramid, 75001 Paris
items.hours: Mon, Thu, Sat, Sun 09:00–18:00; Wed, Fri 09:00–21:00; closed Tue; last entry one hour before closing
items.hoursZh: 周一、周四、周六、周日 09:00–18:00；周三、周五 09:00–21:00；周二闭馆；闭馆前一小时停止入场

exceptions.note: The Louvre may open later, and some rooms may stay closed.
exceptions.noteZh: 卢浮宫可能推迟开门，部分展厅可能关闭。

items.price: €22 for EEA citizens and residents, €32 otherwise; free under 18, and under 26 for EEA citizens and residents. Book a time slot.
items.priceZh: 欧洲经济区公民和居民 €22，其他人 €32；18岁以下免费，欧洲经济区公民和居民26岁以下免费。请预约时段。

image.caption: René Dagron. Grand Ballon à vapeur d’Henri Giffard, 1878. Epreuve argentique
image.alt: A sepia photograph of a crowd of men in top hats beneath the netted underside of a huge balloon, in front of the Louvre.
image.altZh: 一张深褐色调的老照片：一群戴高礼帽的男人站在一只巨大气球的网兜下方，背景是卢浮宫。
image.source: Published by the Musée du Louvre

items.name: Fondation Francès
items.subtitle: FAIRE CORPS — Vingt ans de photographie dans la collection Francès
items.by: Including Diane Arbus, Nan Goldin, Richard Avedon, Robert Mapplethorpe, Raymond Depardon and Annie Leibovitz
items.why: A private collection shows its photographs for the first time; the Clichy half is about the body, in portraits, documents and intimate pictures. Compare how close each photographer is allowed to come.
items.whyZh: 一家私人收藏首次展出它的摄影作品；克利希这一半关于身体，有肖像、纪实和私密的照片。比较每位摄影师被允许靠得多近。
items.hoursZh: 周四至周六 11:00–19:00，须预约；最晚入场 18:00
items.price: Free; booking required.
items.priceZh: 免费；必须预约。
items.note: Métro line 14, Saint-Ouen. Book through the foundation’s Billetweb page.
items.noteZh: 地铁14号线 Saint-Ouen 站。请通过基金会的 Billetweb 页面预约。

image.alt: A black-and-white print of four close-up frames of a wide-open mouth, as if screaming, arranged in a grid.
image.altZh: 一张黑白照片：四格特写排成方阵，都是张得大大的嘴，像在尖叫。

items.name: Editions Firmin-Didot
items.subtitle: Pandora’s Box
items.why: Study deliberate changes to perspective and focus made with a large-format Sinar camera, and the image’s transformation into a photographic object.
items.whyZh: 研究如何用大画幅 Sinar 相机刻意改变透视与焦点，以及影像如何转化为一件摄影物件。
items.hoursZh: 仅限预约，时间在每日 14:30–18:30 之间
items.note: Do not turn up without an appointment. Festival venue page is stricter than its map.
items.noteZh: 没有预约请不要直接前往。摄影节场馆页面的规定比它的地图更严格。

image.alt: Exhibition image: Pandora’s Box
image.altZh: 展览图片：Pandora’s Box

items.name: MUSKHANE
items.subtitle: PARESSE
items.why: Slow looking, analogue photographs and ordinary moments; the project also links images, a book and fragrance.
items.whyZh: 慢慢看：胶片照片与日常瞬间；这个项目还把影像、一本书和一款香氛联系在一起。

image.alt: Exhibition image: PARESSE
image.altZh: 展览图片：PARESSE

items.name: Ritz Paris
items.subtitle: Regards sur le Ritz Paris
items.by: 18 photo and video students of GOBELINS Paris
items.why: Students given a free hand inside a palace hotel: the staff behind the scenes, the building, and what luxury looks like to a new generation.
items.whyZh: 学生们在一家宫殿级酒店里自由拍摄：幕后的员工、建筑本身，以及新一代眼中的奢华。
items.address: Ritz Paris, peristyle, 15 Place Vendôme, 75001 Paris
items.price: Free.
items.priceZh: 免费。
items.note: In the hotel’s peristyle. Paris Photo’s page also mentions the salons, which host its VIP lounge, so not every room may be open.
items.noteZh: 在酒店的列柱廊。Paris Photo 的页面还提到酒店的沙龙厅，那里是它的贵宾休息室，所以不一定每个厅都开放。

image.caption: Efflorescence Intemporelle
image.alt: A soft, layered close-up of pale pink and white flowers against a dark patterned background.
image.altZh: 一张柔和、层次丰富的特写：深色花纹背景前的淡粉色和白色花朵。

items.name: 99 Cameras Museum
items.subtitle: 99 appareils de légende
items.why: A free room of about 99 famous cameras, from Leica and Hasselblad to lesser-known models. See the machines behind the pictures before or after the early processes at Paris Photo.
items.whyZh: 一间免费的小展厅，陈列约99台著名相机，从 Leica、Hasselblad 到不太知名的型号。在 Paris Photo 看早期工艺之前或之后，来看看照片背后的机器。
items.address: Studio Harcourt, 6 Rue de Lota, 75116 Paris
items.price: Free; donations welcome.
items.priceZh: 免费，欢迎捐款。
items.note: Métro line 9, Rue de la Pompe. A free audio guide plays on your phone.
items.noteZh: 地铁9号线 Rue de la Pompe 站。手机上有免费语音导览。

image.caption: Leica I
image.alt: A black 1925 Leica I camera with a silver lens, on a white background.
image.altZh: 一台黑色的 1925 年 Leica I 相机，配银色镜头，白色背景。

items.name: Espace Commines · ECAL
items.subtitle: Soft Photography – Human Emotions and Machine-Generated Images
items.why: Student research on how feeds make us feel: AI-made images, “oddly satisfying” clips, rage-bait. A short visit that sharpens the Digital Sector at Paris Photo.
items.whyZh: 学生们研究信息流如何影响我们的情绪：AI 生成的图像、“莫名舒适”的短片、激怒式内容。短短一看，会让你在 Paris Photo 的数字展区看得更清楚。
items.hours: Fri 13 and Sat 14 Nov 11:00–19:00. Opening Thu 12 Nov from 18:00
items.note: Guided tour in English, Sat 14 Nov at 11:00. ECAL also shows at Paris Photo.
items.noteZh: 11月14日（周六）11:00 有英语导览。ECAL 在 Paris Photo 也有展出。

image.alt: A glossy orange-red sculpted form shaped like a pair of open lips, close up against a pale background.
image.altZh: 一件光亮的橙红色雕塑，形状像一双张开的嘴唇，浅色背景下的特写。

items.name: LSD · Laboratory Scan & Developing
items.subtitle: Cyan Years
items.why: Pictures reworked on the presses of the family print works where the book itself was printed. A short show with the launch, for anyone curious about print as material.
items.whyZh: 作者在自家印刷厂的印刷机上重新加工图像，这本书也是在那里印的。展期很短，与新书发布同时，适合对“印刷即材质”感兴趣的人。
items.hours: Fri 13 Nov (launch) and Sat 14 Nov; times not published
items.hoursZh: 11月13日（周五，发布会）和14日（周六）；开放时间未公布
items.note: A photo lab, not a gallery: check the publisher’s page before going. The book signing is at Paris Photo, Booth K6, Sun 15 Nov 14:00.
items.noteZh: 这是一家冲印实验室，不是画廊：出发前请先查看出版社的页面。签书会在 Paris Photo 的 K6 展位，11月15日（周日）14:00。

image.caption: Jean-Vincent Simonet, Cyan Years, Loose Joints
image.alt: An open copy of the book Cyan Years, its pages showing blue-and-green, ink-stained photographs of a printing works.
image.altZh: 摊开的《Cyan Years》一书，书页上是一家印刷厂的蓝绿色、带墨渍的照片。

items.name: Galerie Madé
items.subtitle: El Rey Blanco
items.why: A colonial legend of a White King and a mountain of silver, read against today’s rush for lithium in the Andes. Watch how an old story is used to frame a present one.
items.whyZh: 一个关于“白色国王”和银山的殖民传说，对照今天安第斯山区对锂矿的争夺。看看一个古老的故事如何被用来讲述当下。
items.hours: Wed–Sat 14:00–19:00, by chance or by appointment
items.hoursZh: 周三至周六 14:00–19:00，随缘或预约
items.note: The festival lists Tue–Sat; the gallery says Wed–Sat. One of its posters gives 5–8 Nov, while the festival and press kit say until 28 Nov. Call before going.
items.noteZh: 摄影节写的是周二至周六，画廊自己写的是周三至周六。画廊的一张海报写11月5日至8日，而摄影节和新闻资料写展至11月28日。出发前请先打电话确认。

image.caption: El Rey Blanco
image.alt: A heap of broken grey rock lit by a shaft of light, with dust hanging in the air.
image.altZh: 一堆碎裂的灰色岩石被一束光照亮，空气中悬浮着灰尘。

items.name: Musée de Minéralogie Mines Paris – PSL
items.subtitle: Temps profonds et autres lumières
items.why: Sculptures and images set among the museum’s fossils, weighing geological time against the changes happening now. Laure Winants is also in the FUTURES show in the Marais.
items.whyZh: 雕塑和图像放在博物馆的化石之间，把地质时间与眼下正在发生的变化放在一起衡量。Laure Winants 也参加了玛黑区的 FUTURES 展。
items.address: 60 Boulevard Saint-Michel, 75006 Paris (inside the École des Mines, second floor)
items.hours: Tue 10:00–12:00 and 13:30–18:00; Wed–Fri 13:30–18:00; Sat 10:00–12:30 and 14:00–17:00; last entry one hour before closing
items.price: €7; reduced €4; free under 26. Buy online: the ticket machine is out of order, and you need a ticket to pass the gates.
items.priceZh: €7；优惠票 €4；26岁以下免费。请在网上购票：现场售票机故障，而且要凭票才能通过入口闸机。
items.note: The festival’s English page gives 15 Nov as the start; the museum and the French page say 5 Nov.
items.noteZh: 摄影节英文页面写11月15日开展；博物馆和法文页面都写11月5日。

image.caption: Time capsule, polarisation 1
image.alt: A square slab of crystallised material glowing turquoise against black, its edges crusted with rainbow-coloured crystals.
image.altZh: 一块方形的结晶体在黑色背景前泛着青绿色的光，边缘结满彩虹色的晶体。

items.name: Librairie Polonaise
items.subtitle: Carte blanche aux éditions Rust Publishing
items.why: A Polish–German photobook collective’s recent books and prints, in a bookshop. Useful after Polycopies, to see small-press making up close.
items.whyZh: 一个波兰与德国东部之间的摄影书团体，在书店里展出近期的书和版画。看过 Polycopies 之后再来，可以近距离看看小型出版是怎么做的。

image.caption: from “FLUX”
image.alt: A wooden house and a bare tree stand in floodwater at night, lit by a flash against a black sky.
image.altZh: 夜里，一座木屋和一棵光秃秃的树立在洪水中，闪光灯照亮了它们，背景是漆黑的天空。

items.name: Musée de la musique – Philharmonie de Paris
items.subtitle: My Rock Stars
items.by: Hassan Hajjaj; music by Acid Arab
items.why: Pattern-filled studio portraits of musicians, with a soundtrack playing through the rooms. A lively contrast to the restraint of Penn’s portraits.
items.whyZh: 满是图案的音乐人棚拍肖像，展厅里一路播放配乐。与 Penn 肖像的克制形成鲜明对比。
items.address: Cité de la musique, 221 Avenue Jean-Jaurès, 75019 Paris
items.price: €12, including the permanent collection; €6 under 26. Booking required.
items.priceZh: €12，含常设展；26岁以下 €6。必须预约。
items.note: Métro line 5, Porte de Pantin.
items.noteZh: 地铁5号线 Porte de Pantin 站。

image.caption: Hassan Hajjaj, My Rock Stars, installation view
image.alt: Two large, brightly coloured Hassan Hajjaj portraits framed with rows of food tins hang on a gallery wall.
image.altZh: 展墙上挂着两幅 Hassan Hajjaj 的大幅彩色肖像，画框上镶着一排排食品罐头。
image.source: Published by the Philharmonie de Paris
image.sourceZh: 由巴黎爱乐音乐厅发布

items.name: Catacombes de Paris
items.subtitle: Nadar : inventer Paris, des profondeurs au ciel
items.why: About fifteen reproductions of Nadar’s 1860s pictures of the ossuary and sewers, made with electric light, beside his balloon views of Paris. Go only if you are visiting the Catacombs anyway.
items.whyZh: 约十五张复制品，是 Nadar 在1860年代用电光拍摄的地下骨库和下水道，旁边是他从热气球上拍的巴黎。只有本来就要去地下墓穴时才值得顺路一看。
items.address: 1 Avenue du Colonel Henri Rol-Tanguy, 75014 Paris (entrance building, ground floor)
items.hoursZh: 周二至周日 09:45–20:30；最晚入场 19:30；周一闭馆
items.price: Only with a Catacombs ticket: €31, reduced €25 (ages 18–26 and students). Timed tickets online, on sale 7 days ahead.
items.priceZh: 只能凭地下墓穴门票参观：€31，优惠票 €25（18至26岁和学生）。分时段门票在网上出售，提前7天开售。
items.note: The Catacombs visit has 131 steps down and 112 up and isn’t wheelchair accessible. The Musée de la Libération (Robert Capa) is across the road.
items.noteZh: 参观地下墓穴要下131级、上112级台阶，轮椅无法通行。马路对面是解放博物馆（Robert Capa 展）。

image.credit: Musée Carnavalet – Histoire de Paris. CC0 Paris Musées
image.caption: Nadar, Façade n°12. Catacombes de Paris, 1862
image.alt: A sepia photograph of a stone cross with a Latin inscription between two obelisks, in front of walls of stacked skulls and bones.
image.altZh: 一张深褐色调的照片：两座方尖碑之间立着刻有拉丁文的石十字架，背后是堆叠的头骨和骨头砌成的墙。
image.source: Published by the Catacombes de Paris

items.name: Musée de l’Homme
items.subtitle: Les grands âges
items.why: Portraits and everyday scenes of very old people, set beside a researcher’s findings on ageing. Notice how science and portraiture each claim to describe a life.
items.whyZh: 高龄老人的肖像和日常场景，与一位研究者关于衰老的发现并置。留意科学与肖像各自如何声称能描述一个人的一生。
items.address: 17 Place du Trocadéro et du 11 Novembre, 75116 Paris
items.hours: Wed–Mon 11:00–19:00; last entry 18:15; closed Tue. Closed 8–11 Nov 2026
items.hoursZh: 周三至周一 11:00–19:00；最晚入场 18:15；周二闭馆。2026年11月8日至11日闭馆
items.price: €15; reduced €12; one ticket covers the whole museum.
items.priceZh: €15；优惠票 €12；一张票可参观整个博物馆。
items.note: Métro Trocadéro, exit 6. Open 12–15 Nov this week.
items.noteZh: 地铁 Trocadéro 站6号出口。本周只在11月12日至15日开放。

image.caption: Pas vus, pas pris
image.alt: A black-and-white street photograph of an elderly woman in sunglasses and a beret gesturing at a café table, while an elderly man behind her takes a picture.
image.altZh: 一张黑白街头照片：一位戴墨镜和贝雷帽的老妇人在咖啡桌旁比划着，她身后一位老先生正在拍照。
image.source: Published by the Musée de l’Homme
